body:
Having a wide preview is awkward when you're navigating directories, but desirable when previewing files.

It'd nice to preview files wide, but directories narrow, so the interface is cleaner. For example, I'd have everything set to 30, which'd give a nice clean browsing experience, except for file previews, which I'd make 90.

What I was, perhaps poorly trying to explain is, that I'd prefer it if I could make all the windows fixed width, except for _file_ previews which'd be larger. When you're previewing directories at a larger width, especially if you're navigating back in the tree, makes the display kind crazy and hard to follow.

Ideally, I'd be able to configure _file_ previews separately from directory previews, so the navigation of directories is consistent, but the preview of files is larger.
